name: BongoCat
body:
## Changelog

### ✨ Features

- Model folders containing multiple levels of nested directories can now be imported.
- The Windows installer now asks which language to use.
- Added a "Model behavior → Allow overlapping motions" setting.
- Added a "Model window → Window behavior → Window mode" setting on Windows.
- Added a "Model window → Window appearance → Window background color" setting on Windows.
- Window mode and window background color can be used together, so OBS can capture the model window properly on Windows.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the cat window missing from OBS's default window list on macOS.
- Fixed model windows losing their aspect ratio in some cases.
- Fixed "The selected model could not be activated" appearing when switching to some models.

### 🌍 Localization

Added French.

## Downloads

- **Windows 10+**: [x64](https://github.com/ayangweb/BongoCat/releases/download/v2.3.0/BongoCat_2.3.0_x64.exe) | ARM64 (runs the x64 build through emulation)
- **macOS 12+**: [Apple Silicon](https://github.com/ayangweb/BongoCat/releases/download/v2.3.0/BongoCat-2.3.0-aarch64.dmg) | [Intel](https://github.com/ayangweb/BongoCat/releases/download/v2.3.0/BongoCat-2.3.0-x64.dmg) | [Homebrew](https://github.com/ayangweb/Homebrew-BongoCat)

## More models

- [Awesome-BongoCat](https://github.com/ayangweb/Awesome-BongoCat)

## Sponsors

- [NexaRelay](https://api.nexarelay.com)
- [ChooseC API](https://api.choosec.cn)

---

## 更新日志

### ✨ 新功能

- 支持导入包含多层嵌套目录的模型文件夹。
- Windows 安装向导新增语言选择功能。
- 新增「模型行为 → 叠加播放动作」配置项。
- Windows 平台新增「模型窗口 → 窗口行为 → 窗口模式」配置项。

- 修复切换部分模型时提示「无法启用所选模型」的问题。

### 🌍 本地化

- 新增法语本地化。

name: BiliPai
body:
v0.3.4 (2026-10-11)
更新日志(ChangeLog)
[添加] 视频最后 5 秒显示“接下来观看”卡片，优先提示下一分 P 或合集下一集，否则提供相关推荐，显示随播放进度变化的剩余秒数
[更改] MD3 音量与亮度反馈采用顶部横向布局，补齐状态栏和刘海规避，调整进度条与数字间距，数字切换增加弹性位移与模糊，不再显示百分号
[适配] Miuix 音量与亮度反馈采用库提供的滑块与图标组件，搭配紧凑深色半透明底板，改善视频画面上的辨识度
[更改] MD3 首页顶部标签改为下划线，统一公共下划线的位移动画参数，保留系统减少动态效果设置
[修复] 热门分类长文字裁切、相关推荐更多按钮过大，以及回顶按钮与长按拖动交接时的重复形变问题
[更改] 视频优先启动，相关推荐独立加载，补齐加载骨架、超时重试和返回详情后的恢复，兼容平板及折叠屏多栏布局
[修复] 评论视频链接返回时串用首页卡片位置，以及长时间播放后的返回快照交接问题，改善横向视频卡片返回时封面与信息区衔接
[适配] 完善主题弹窗、滑块、开关、浮动工具栏与可拖动滚动条，补齐液态玻璃按压、拖动回弹及嵌套弹窗模糊
[修复] 加固液态玻璃背景采样、图片预览缩放与退出手势、网页导航及外链返回栈，补充 WorkManager 启动时的系统 API 优化隔离规则
[添加] 动态详情支持互动用户列表与分页加载，动画设置支持蓝雪女仆显示开关，默认开启并支持设置分享
[修复] 改善相册二维码采样与旋转识别，避免无关结果中断识别并释放临时图片 [更改] versionCode 451，版本名保持 0.3.4
[合并] #893 修复冷启动后首次切换动态页的首帧闪烁；#894 新增动态评论摘要开关并稳定详情链接标签；#895 优化视频详情加载与弱网相关推荐调度。感谢 @1290000
[合并] #897 修复歌词罗马音与动态图文表情丢失；#898 将 JVM 守卫迁移为语义 Lint 检查并移除脆弱源码断言。感谢 @CoderTCY
[修复] 补齐番剧播放器功能、字幕状态、公共标签字体与直播封面保存组件，恢复相关引用
[更改] 播放器亮度反馈统一使用资源定义的黄色，不再跟随主题色
[适配] 液态玻璃开启时，设置开关与滑块复用现有 Miuix Backdrop，按 Kyant 交互实现；关闭时使用对应主题原生控件
[修复] 滑块拖动直接跟随手指，释放后处理步进吸附；补齐开关切换反馈与背景采样，调整滑块黑色背景问题
[修复] 收敛玻璃组件重复形变，统一 dock 内容与外壳的交互；可滚动顶栏外壳接入共享拖动与回弹状态，恢复回顶按钮短拖拉伸反馈
[修复] 直播聊天页与完整聊天弹层同步标签选择，恢复时直接定位
[调整] 优化搜索页文字层级、区块间距与历史删除触点，统一弹幕发送文字样式

name: WWPlayer
body:
##新功能
- 新增简体中文、繁体中文和英文界面，元数据语言可独立设置。
- 新增未加密蓝光 ISO 原盘播放支持。
- 新增主／副双字幕，可分别选择、关闭、调整样式与同步偏移，支持跟随主字幕或独立定位。
- 本地视频支持自动匹配视频同名文件夹内的外挂字幕。
- 在线字幕支持中文、英文、日文及来源筛选，提供下载进度与取消操作。
- 新增上一／下一章节快捷键，默认使用 PageUp／PageDown。
- 新增 TMDB 支持自定义资料 API、图片地址与独立连接检查。
- 新增TMDB搜索结果切换
- 新增整季弹幕匹配，支持逐集选择来源与调整偏移。
##优化
- 直播改用主播放器，完善频道分组、搜索与逐步加载，简化在线列表、本地 M3U/M3U8 文件及单个直播地址的配置。
- 优化时间轴预览，优先使用 Emby/Jellyfin 服务端缩略图，改善快速拖动时的画面更新与取消操作。
- 重整字幕选择与调整菜单。
- 加快详情页与跨服务器资源加载，减少重复查询与等待。
- 简化服务器和模块管理卡片，改善资源列表布局与长标题显示。
- 完善弹幕匹配与多格式读取，调整来源偏移时无需重新加载弹幕。
- 评分支持跳转到对应影片页面，改善 Trakt 列表的滚动体验。
- 细节优化。
##修复
- 修复长时间暂停、系统睡眠后播放恢复异常，恢复时保留暂停状态与播放进度。
- 修复部分资源起播卡住、正常缓冲被误报为失败，以及预加载和切集状态异常。
- 修复音轨／字幕切换误触发播放恢复，以及换集后轨道偏好恢复错误。
- 修复跨服务器剧集身份、播放来源错配及聚合资源漏项。
- 修复来源服务器不可用时继续观看详情无法打开，以及 Trakt 进度清除不完整的问题。
- 修复 WebDAV 媒体源恢复后缺失、凭据查看异常及部分签名地址无法播放的问题。
- 修复模块播放、预加载、外置播放器与部分补充资料请求未遵循软件代理的问题。
- 修复本地头像保存依赖云同步及重启后头像丢失的问题。
- 修复主窗口最大化状态恢复、播放器键盘焦点与控制栏自动隐藏异常。
- 修复 NEXUS 分享类型识别、文件导入安装统计与分享归属异常。

name: cc-switch
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.9

### 4.0 正式版的第五个修复版本

重新梳理了添加供应商的整个流程：表单按填写顺序排列，地址和 Key 之后就是模型列表；点「获取模型列表」后弹窗自动打开，每个模型的上下文窗口、是否支持推理和图片输入都已经查好，勾选后点「应用」就连同参数一起加进列表，同一个弹窗里取消勾选就能移除；字段说明收进「?」，提示会按应用当前是直连、路由还是聚合来显示。另外修复了 Codex 新建线程和自动化在部分上游报错、整个线程无法继续的问题：经路由转成 Chat 协议的 DeepSeek、OpenCode Zen 等报 400，xAI 原生 Responses 报 422。WSL2 里的 Claude Desktop 等连不上本机回环的客户端，现在可以在「设置 → 本地路由」填一个「连接地址」。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.9-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.9-ja.md)**

---

## 重新梳理的供应商添加流程

这一版把添加和编辑供应商的表单从头到尾理了一遍，主要是 Claude Code、Codex 和聚合三种布局。以前模型列表收在高级选项里，排在它所决定的默认模型后面；获取到的模型只能在列表下方逐个添加，加完还要逐个核对自动填好的参数；几乎每个字段下面都有一段灰字，有些提示和你实际所处的模式对不上。现在按填写顺序走一遍：

**1. 地址、Key 和上游格式。** 先选预设或填地址和 Key。选上游格式时，提示按应用当前的模式显示：应用处在直连模式时，如果选的格式需要转换，格式下面会提示这张卡正在直连使用、改成这种格式保存后请求会失败，或者这种格式要先切到路由或聚合才能用。Claude Code 的上游格式选 OpenAI Chat 或 Responses 时，不再显示用不上的认证字段。

**2. 模型列表：获取、挑选、自动填参数。** Codex 的模型列表从高级选项里挪了出来，紧跟在地址和 Key 后面，和聚合布局一样叫「模型列表」。Claude Code 聚合、Codex、OpenCode 和 MiniMax Code 的模型列表现在这样添加模型：

1. 点模型列表上的「获取模型列表」。
2. 获取成功后「选择模型」弹窗自动打开。每个模型旁边已经显示好上下文窗口，以及是否支持推理和图片输入，数值来自同地址的预设，其次按供应商地址查 models.dev，再其次查模型厂商自己的条目。
3. 勾选想要的模型，点「应用」。新模型追加到列表末尾，参数按弹窗里显示的值直接填好，不再弹「已补全……的上下文等参数，请核对」的提示。

同一个弹窗也负责删除：勾选表示「在列表里」，已配置的模型默认勾选，取消勾选后点「应用」就会从列表移除，点「取消」什么都不改。留下的模型保持原来的顺序和设置。已配置但供应商这次没返回的模型，单独列在「不在供应商列表中」一组，也能一并清理。弹窗支持搜索、全选 / 全不选、只看已选，并显示已选数量；获取过一次后按钮变成「选择模型」，再点不会重新获取，需要时在弹窗里点「重新获取」。

**3. 默认模型：列表第一行。** Codex 有模型列表时，第一行就是默认模型，不再单独有一个默认模型输入框；改名或删掉第一行，默认模型跟着变。列表原本为空时，添加模型会自动把当前的默认模型放在第一行，默认模型不会因为加了列表而变掉。没有配置模型列表的卡仍然保留默认模型输入框：这类卡用的是 Codex 自带的 `/model` 菜单，加上列表后菜单里只会剩下列表里的模型。聚合模型列表也去掉了每行的 ★ 和「设为默认模型」，规则同样是第一行即默认。

**4. 子代理（Codex，新增）。** Codex 表单新增「子代理模型」和「子代理推理强度」，对应 `config.toml` 里 `[agents]` 下的 `default_subagent_model` 和 `default_subagent_reasoning_effort`。留空就删掉对应的键，子代理沿用主代理的设置；切换供应商时这两项跟着换，`[agents]` 下的其他设置不动。填的模型不在模型列表里时，表

name: oh-my-openagent
body:
**`ulw-research` reads sources in your own browser instead of fetching them.** The Phase 0 brief now decides `Collection: search-only | browser` by one rule (search-only only when a result snippet settles every axis), and the web workers read every candidate through the `browser` skill's attached engine: one named session per worker, one tab per source, several tabs side by side while comparing, with a full-page screenshot per top source. `webfetch` is reserved for raw files, hosts the browser cannot open go to `ultimate-browsing` with their provenance, and a team member's brief names the `browser` skill to read since members cannot carry `load_skills`. `ultimate-browsing` no longer presents itself as the research browsing lane, and the `browser` skill no longer sends plain page reading elsewhere. ([#9958](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9958), [#9959](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9959))

**Your first real prompt starts onboarding, not opening a session.** First-run context now rides along with the first prompt you actually send, without a separate model turn. The agent answers your request first, then offers the tour. Background, preview and headless sessions no longer use up onboarding, the TUI shows a static welcome until you ask something, and a failed or aborted first turn frees onboarding to try again. `--onboard` still starts the tour right away in the TUI, and in RPC it applies to the first real prompt. ([#9905](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9905), [#9907](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9907))

**Custom category models keep their own reasoning settings when background work starts or resumes.** A category with a model override or a `models` chain no longer inherits the builtin category's variant. name: qwen-image-local
body:
### 中文

**Turbo 速度档位**：官方蒸馏的 8 步权重，采样比标准 20–40 步快约 3–4 倍。它与显存档位、模型选择相互独立——均衡档和紧凑档都能开 Turbo；无审查模型暂无 Turbo 权重，会自动回落到标准档。应用内（安装界面和主界面）与命令行（`qil setup --speed turbo` / `qil config --speed turbo`）均可选择。

**参考图标注编辑器**：参考图送进模型前可以先画、圈、框、加箭头、擦除或裁剪。9 色预设 + 自定义取色、3 档笔宽、撤销/重做（40 步）、整图 90° 旋转、Ctrl+滚轮缩放，取代原来的旋转按钮。编辑结果另存为新 PNG，绝不修改你的原始文件。

**点击看大图**：参考图和生成结果点击即可放大预览，看的是原图而不是缩略图。

**配置即时保存**：速度选择现在和其他安装项一样，选定即落盘，不点安装也不会丢。

安装包：下载 `Qwen.Image.Local_0.3.0_x64-setup.exe`，双击安装即可。首次启动会检测 GPU、安装引擎并下载权重（约 19.5 GB，仅一次）。

---

### English

**Turbo speed tier**: the official distilled 8-step checkpoint, about 3–4× faster sampling than the standard 20–40 steps. It is independent of the VRAM profile and the model choice — Turbo works on Balanced and Compact alike; the Uncensored model has no Turbo weights yet and falls back to the standard checkpoint. Pick it in the app (setup screen and main UI) or the CLI (`qil setup --speed turbo` / `qil config --speed turbo`).

**Markup editor for reference photos**: draw, circle, box, arrow, erase or crop a photo before it goes into the model. 9-color palette plus custom colors, three brush widths, undo/redo (40 steps), whole-image 90° rotation and Ctrl+wheel zoom — replacing the old rotate-only button. Edits are saved as new PNGs; your original files are never touched.

**Click to zoom**: reference photos and the result open a full-size preview; you see the original, not the thumbnail.

**Instant config persistence**: the speed choice is saved to disk the moment you pick it, like every other setup option.

Installer: download `Qwen.Image.Local_0.3.0_x64-setup.exe` and run it. The first launch detects your GPU, installs the engine and downloads the weights (~19.5 GB, one time).

name: dsh-our-free-model
body:
## 聚合 API、省 Token、降级链与原生 Anthropic 网关

- **聚合渠道（自带 Key）**：注册表内置 76 家提供商（NVIDIA NIM、OpenRouter、Groq、Cerebras、DeepSeek、SiliconFlow、Z.ai、Kimi、MiniMax、QwenCloud、Azure OpenAI，以及免账号的 Ollama、LM Studio、llama.cpp 等）。写入 Key 后其模型以 `provider/model` 进入选择器与本地网关；Key 只写入 0600 的 settings.json，接口永不回显，只显示 `hasKey` 与 `…abcd` 指纹。每家可单独启停、测试（列表探测，不花一次生成）、发现模型、覆盖 Base URL 与模型清单；OAuth/ADC 提供商照常列出并标注「不可驱动」。
- **省 Token**：工具输出压缩（RTK）在请求发出前就地重写 `tool_result`——git diff/status/log、grep、find、ls、tree、构建与包管理器日志、编号转储、搜索清单、重复日志行；实测 40 KB 的 `git diff` 移除 90% 字节且模型仍能就它作答。报错结果永不触碰、替换永不大于原文、过滤器抛错原样放行、整条管线幂等，对全部车道生效，默认开启。另有两族提示词瘦身（caveman / ponytail，默认关）与五个不占上游请求的本地应答（额度探测、命令前缀、会话标题、建议模式、文件路径提取）。
- **路由（降级链）**：把任意车道的模型串成命名链，以 `combo:<name>` 作为虚拟模型出现在选择器与网关上。`fallback` 固定从链首开始，`round-robin` 轮换起点并连续 N 轮粘滞。链接在输出任何正文之前失败会被整段丢弃，切换对调用方不可见——「想了很久才撞上配额墙」正是降级最有价值的场景。
- **本地网关原生说 Anthropic**：新增 `POST /v1/messages`（流式与非流式，含 thinking / tool_use 块、真实 stop_reason 与流内 error 事件）与 `POST /v1/messages/count_tokens`（本地估算）。Claude Code 与 Anthropic 各 SDK 可直接指向本插件；网关页新增「接入客户端」分区，按实际端口与真实密钥生成可复制配方。
- **稳定性修复**：combo 链的降级判定修复——此前候选产出过思考增量后即使失败也不再切换（思考不算交付）；思考块的收尾帧不再被当作提交点；工具调用在 id 迟到的流上不再折叠出重复调用。设置页扩为九页，新增聚合渠道、省 Token、路由三页，并与独立服务架构、图片计价、三套 UI 世界观完成整合。

name: QuickView
body:
# QuickView v6.52.5.0 Pre-Release

> [!NOTE]
> ### 📢 Notice Regarding Development Progress
> Hey everyone, please accept my sincere apologies as updates and active development will be temporarily paused for approximately one month due to an important work commitment that requires my full attention.
> 
> During this period, if you encounter any bugs or unexpected behavior, please feel free to report them in the Issues tab as usual. I will check in whenever I find some spare time; however, I likely won't be able to push out immediate fixes. Once the current task is concluded, I will be back right away to resume active development. Thank you all so much for your continuous support and understanding! ❤️

---

### What's Changed

#### 1. Window State & Shell Controls
* **Seamless Restore on Minimized Activation (#144)**:
  * Resolved an issue where clicking a minimized QuickView window on the Windows Taskbar in custom frameless mode could fail to restore the window and trigger a Windows Shell alert beep.
  * Windows activation messages (`WM_ACTIVATE`) arriving while in an iconic or minimized state now immediately issue `ShowWindow(SW_RESTORE)`, synchronizing state transitions smoothly.
* **Standardized Window Minimization**:
  * Standardized the custom titlebar minimize button to dispatch `SC_MINIMIZE` via `WM_SYSCOMMAND`, aligning with standard Windows shell conventions.

#### 2. Shell Drag & Drop Performance
* **Immediate Drag-and-Drop Lock Release**:
  * Invoked `DragFinish` earlier during `WM_DROPFILES` processing. This releases the exclusive lock held by Windows Explorer (or external drag sources) immediately, eliminating minor interface hangs in source windows and improving drag-and-drop responsiveness.

#### 3. Code Hygiene & Cleanup
* **Removed Redundant Global Variables (#261)**:
  * Cleaned up the unused global variable `g_windowDpi`, keeping the core codebase concise and maintainable.

---

### 💖 Special Thanks to Contributors

body:
## What's Changed

### More Control
- **iCloud Ordering** (45c0f36d, 238c6ae1)
  Filter and userscript order now syncs across devices. Reset Ordering restores the defaults across your devices too.
- **Cosmetic Filtering by Site** (5f79cfb7)
  Choose where cosmetic filtering applies, or exclude specific sites while keeping network blocking on.
- **Per-list Automatic Updates** (1b72f810, d2782dd9)
  Each URL-based filter list has its own Automatic Updates switch. Your choices sync and are included in backups.
- **Per-list Site Exclusions** (6d78f9fa, 2a895cbf)
  Site Settings shows which lists exclude each site, and every edit stays undoable.

### Imports & Interface
- **Rebuilt Add Sheets** (15db8148, 78040461, 90632ade)
  Native URL, Text and File tabs, an import review step with editable metadata, and bulk URL imports from text files.
- **Source Editor** (2bfaf00e)
  One editor for rules and script content, with Undo, Redo, Paste, Search and Wrap.
- **Settings at a Glance** (1e8455ad, 423b60a8)
  Rule Capacity, Next Update and iCloud Sync summaries, plus Pause Blocking in the Settings toolbar.
- **Info Panels & Toolbars** (5dd66184, d1aac55f, 540b10dd, e73a80b4)
  Better-anchored Mac popovers, native sheet navigation, Dynamic Type icon sizing and a standard Show Enabled Only toggle.

name: whatcable
body:
# Charging state you can trust, read live

Beta build for testers. Not recommended for general use.

## Charging state

WhatCable now reads the charging state live from the Mac's System Management Controller (SMC), the chip that runs charging. Before, it waited on macOS's battery record, which can take a minute to catch up.

- After you plug in, the popover shows charging within a few seconds. It no longer says "Plugged in, charging on hold" for the first minute (#634, thanks @official-Cromatin).
- The open popover updates by itself. You no longer need to close and reopen it.
- New: **"Plugged in, charge limit reached"** when macOS has stopped charging at the level it's charging the battery to.
- New: **"Plugged in, running on battery"** when the charger is connected but the Mac isn't taking power from it. It only shows once this has lasted 2 seconds, so the brief blip every Mac has at plug-in never appears.
- The widget and the `whatcable` CLI show the same state as the popover.
- Macs without these SMC keys, desktops included, behave exactly as before.

## Also in here

- Ports: the "USB active" row is gone, because macOS reports it as true on every port. The SuperSpeed row now only shows a live, confirmed USB 3 link (#532).
- The app language setting now reaches the menus too, and macOS's own strings follow it.
- The hardware read that runs every second no longer runs on the main thread, so the popover stays responsive.
- The cable database gains reports #541, #625 and #631.

## What to look at

- Plug in with the popover open: does it say charging within a few seconds?
- If you use a charge limit (or Optimized Battery Charging is holding at 80%): does it say "charge limit reached"?
- Do the widget and the popover agree?
- Did you ever see "Plugged in, running on battery"? Tell me what was plugged in at the time.

Install by downloading WhatCable.zip below, unzipping, and dragging WhatCable.app into /Applications over your existing copy.

body:
# BoxPlayer v5.0.36 本次更新集中完善统一媒体库与音乐体验：统一各页面海报与详情页布局，改进首页和文件来源的拖动排序，补齐系列、播放列表与分类浏览；音乐库改为歌曲、歌手、专辑和自建歌单入口，并改进粒子播放器的切换；Trakt 支持系统浏览器登录、待看列表和个人评分同步。 ## 统一媒体库与首页管理 - 主屏幕、分类、搜索结果和媒体服务器列表采用统一的海报尺寸、圆角、标题与年份布局，改进封面清晰度。 - 收藏夹使用彩色卡片，音乐、书籍与媒体服务器显示对应图标；补齐系列入口并去掉重复的收藏夹管理项。 - 首页管理支持拖动整行调整顺序，保存栏目顺序和显示设置；二级管理页面与一级页面保持一致宽度。 - 文件来源列表可直接拖动右侧手柄进行整行排序；网格选择「重新排序」后显示卡片抖动提示。 - 媒体库初次加载显示加载指示，改进空状态，删除列表顶部多余的说明文字。 - 修正继续观看卡片的本地进度比例，卡片底部显示清晰的橙色播放进度条。 ### 主屏幕 ![BoxPlayer v5.0.36 统一媒体库主屏幕](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gaozhangmin/boxplayer/v5.0.36/screenshot/library-home.png) ## 媒体详情与分类浏览 - 扩大详情页背景图展示区域，去掉右侧独立圆角容器，统一底部内容对齐与按钮圆角。 - 修复暗色模式无背景图时出现白色区域的问题，调整简介与评分的间距。 - 有历史进度时，播放按钮显示进度及「继续：时间」提示。 - 媒体库与媒体服务器的集封面中央增加播放入口，简化重复的季标题。 - 系列和播放列表共用选择弹窗；海报菜单与详情页使用相同的选择界面，更多操作收纳到下拉菜单。 - 改进类型、年份、地区和演员的分类筛选与页面标题，从分类页返回时恢复原详情页。 - 移除媒体库详情页底部冗余的「详细信息」区块。 ### 剧集详情 ![BoxPlayer v5.0.36 剧集详情与播放入口](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gaozhangmin/boxplayer/v5.0.36/screenshot/episode-detail.png) ## 媒体服务器与文件来源 - Emby、Jellyfin、Plex 使用各自的品牌图标，服务器支持自定义图标。 - 调整编辑共享与选择封面的入口，非媒体服务器来源不显示选择封面菜单。 - 新增服务器端点管理弹窗，支持添加、编辑和选择不同连接地址。 - 统一服务器海报列表、收藏分类与媒体操作的展示。 ### 媒体服务器海报列表 ![BoxPlayer v5.0.36 媒体服务器海报列表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gaozhangmin/boxplayer/v5.0.36/screenshot/server-library.png) ## 音乐库与粒子播放器 - 音乐库提供歌曲、歌手、专辑与我的歌单四个入口，支持搜索、创建歌单及从列表播放。 - 播放歌曲或「播放全部」时进入粒子播放器；返回音乐库后仍可通过底部播放条控制和再次进入。 - 修正队列标题显示全部歌曲、弹窗却只展示当前歌曲附近少量曲目的问题；现在可以滚动查看完整队列。 - 改进音乐元数据与封面展示，并保留歌词、音效及粒子可视化设置。

## Trakt 登录与同步 - 点击 Trakt 图标后直接打开系统浏览器授权，并通过应用回调完成登录。 - 登录后可将待看列表增删和个人评分同步到 Trakt；操作期间显示加载反馈，菜单按当前状态切换加入或移除。 - 账户弹窗展示用户名、头像、观看统计、同步开关与退出登录；修复弹窗宽度跳变和头像加载时的白色占位。 - 登录凭据由主进程加密保存；Trakt client_id 统一从本地环境配置和 Gi

- **贴图更好用**：可设置贴图阴影，隐藏、恢复贴图窗口，改善窗口大小与内容的匹配。
- **截图更流畅、更省内存**：改善选区拖动与显示的流畅度，空闲时减少内存占用；再次截图时，光标显示更稳定。
- **日常操作更稳定**：改善序号文字样式、设置修改、长菜单和弹窗关闭，修复更新下载进度显示。

## What's new

- **More flexible measurement and annotation:** measure angles, edit distances by their calibrated value, use bold and italic text, customize color presets, and remember watermark text across captures.
- **Easier formula and table recognition (Full edition):** preview and edit recognized LaTeX formulas, and choose a vision model for table and formula recognition.
- **Better pinned images:** customize shadows, hide and restore pinned windows, and get improved sizing around their content.
- **Smoother capture, lower idle memory use:** smoother selection dragging and display, less memory use while idle, and more consistent cursor display when taking another screenshot.
- **Everyday reliability:** improved numbered text styles, settings edits, long menus, popup dismissal, and update download progress.

name: superpowers
body:
We rebuilt brainstorming from scratch so it does a much better job of what it was always for: helping you work out what you actually want and put it into words before anything gets built. The new skill asks you to describe what you're after and why, plays back what it heard so you can correct it, and keeps asking good questions until the picture is clear. Then it matches the process to the work, from just doing it to writing a full design. 

This release also adds a native plugin manifest for the Antigravity Marketplace and fixes Windows hook discovery, Git Bash paths, Hermes skill descriptions, and several smaller bugs.

### Brainstorming

- **Brainstorming draws out what you want before it proposes anything.** Its first message offers to skip the questions and asks one open question about a real moment or a concrete picture. It offers a menu only when you're stuck. Along the way, it offers to look at prior art, your project, or the web. As it understands each part, it plays that part back in a few hundred words and marks its guesses as guesses. (#2463)
- **It sizes the work after it understands what you want, and says so in plain words.** It does a quick, clear task right away, agrees a small change with you in chat, and writes a design document for a project. You can override its call, and it steps up a size if the work grows. (#2463)
- **A builder check replaces the spec-document reviewer.** A fresh subagent reads the design as the person who'll build it and lists what they'd still need to ask. Brainstorming answers what it can, makes the minor calls itself and marks them as its own, and brings you the questions that change what gets built, in one round. (#2463)
- **It finds out which choices about how the thing gets made you want to own.** Platform, language, libraries, medium: if you have strong views, it talks them through; if you hand them over, it picks sensible defaults and tells you what it picked. name: Auto_Bangumi
body:
# [4.0] — Beta

4.0 是插件化重构的大版本：下载、通知、解析、搜索、重命名与整理都通过同一套扩展点实现，内置功能与第三方插件走相同的接口。下载器可以有多个实例，重命名、硬链接、种子过滤与媒体库刷新由内置插件提供。只支持从 3.3.x 升级，第一次启动时自动迁移配置并备份原文件。

升级步骤、回滚方法与升级后的检查项见 [从 3.3 升级到 4.0](../deploy/upgrade-4.0)。

## 4.0.0-beta.1

Docker 镜像：`ghcr.io/estrellaxd/auto_bangumi:4.0.0-beta.1`（`dev-latest` 也指向最新测试版）。

### 破坏性变更

- **只支持从 3.3.x 升级。** 检测到更早版本的数据（`config/version.info` 低于 3.3，或残留 2.x 的 `data/data.json`）时拒绝启动，并提示先升级到最新的 3.3.x 启动一次。
- **配置结构变化，自动迁移。** 下载器改为 `plugins.instances` 中的实例，`plugins.slots.downloader` 指向默认实例；重命名方式与版本冲突策略移到 `plugins.slots.rename_strategy` / `plugins.slots.conflict_policy`。第一次启动时自动迁移 3.3 的 `downloader`、`bangumi_manage.rename_method`、`bangumi_manage.revision_conflict_policy`，原文件备份为 `config.json.v3.bak`（已有备份时另存为 `config.json.v3.bak.1` 等，不覆盖）。迁移失败时 `config.json` 保持原样、拒绝启动，日志写明出错的字段。`AB_DOWNLOADER_*`、`AB_DOWNLOAD_PATH`、`AB_METHOD`、`AB_REVISION_CONFLICT_POLICY` 环境变量照常生效。
- **通知渠道旧字段。** Bark 不再读取 `token`（改用 `device_key`），WeCom 不再读取 `chat_id`（改用 `webhook_url`）。升级时自动迁移。
- **移除旧 API。** 3.2 兼容的 GET 控制端点（`/api/v1/restart`、`/start`、`/stop`、`/shutdown`）和 `GET /api/v1/auth/refresh_token` 已移除，请改用 POST。
- **移除旧配置。** 移除 `experimental_openai` 配置节与通知的单渠道旧字段（3.3 已迁移到 `llm` 与 `notification.providers`）；移除废弃的 `normal` 重命名方式，已有配置自动改为行为相同的 `none`。
- 数据库自动升级到 schema v26（新增插件存储表与 `downloader_id` 列）。

### 插件系统

- 新增插件运行时：插件可以来自内置目录、签名插件目录、本地目录（`config/plugins/local/`）或 pip 包。本地与 pip 插件未签名，需开启 **设置 → 插件 → 允许未签名插件**（`plugins.allow_unsigned`）才会加载。
- 插件可以提供下载器、通知渠道、LLM 解析提供商、搜索站点、元数据源和定时任务。内置的 qBittorrent / aria2 与各通知渠道走同一套扩展点。下载器类型、通知渠道、订阅解析器的下拉框会列出插件提供的选项。
- 插件可以在 RSS 下载流程中过滤种子、修正解析结果、修改保存路径 / 分类 / 标签，或为私有站点的请求添加 Cookie 等请求头。
- 设置页新增「插件」卡片：查看状态、启停插件，并通过自动生成的表单修改插件配置；秘密字段在读取接口中一律掩码。
- 签名插件目录：`GET /api/v1/plugins/catalog` 列出目录中的插件，`POST /api/v1/plugins/{id}/install` 验证 sha256 与 ed25519 签名后安装并启用，`DELETE /api/v1/plugins/{id}` 卸载。
- 插件的钩子调用有超时。同一插件连续失败 5 次后被自动禁用，修复后在设置页重新启用即可。

### 多下载器

- **设置 → 下载设置** 可以添加多个下载器实例（qBittorrent、aria2 或插件提供的下载器）并指定默认实例。
- 规则与 RSS 订阅可以选择下载器，留空时用默认实

name: iPhoneMirror
body:
iPhoneMirror 1.8.5-pre → 1.8.5-pre2 完整更新日志

发布日期：2026-10-09。版本性质：预览版。

对比范围：`v1.8.5-pre`（54c36cad597e995dbfb3999de42287082d22cce9）到 `v1.8.5-pre2`（5a260d7e25e040481959ff86913341e7db24b97a）。
本清单根据发布标签的实际代码差异、CHANGELOG 的新增记录及对应功能文档整理。下列修复是实现变更，不表示所有设备和网络场景都已完成实机验收。

## 一、新增首次设置助手与设置检查

- 新增首次设置助手，涵盖基础偏好、应用模式、外观、使用方式、设备配置、无线组件和画质设置。
- 支持无线投屏、有线投屏、投屏与反控等不同用途，按选择跳过不需要的功能。
- 设置助手仅首次启动自动显示；首次显示即保存进入记录，未完成也不会在每次启动时重复弹出。
- 保留应用偏好、投屏设置和开发者选项中的手动入口，保留未完成进度和已有设备档案。
- 每次手动进入先检查实际设置，再显示汇总；支持重新检查、处理缺项及重新配置全部设置。
- 按已完成、未完成、无效、不需要、未知区分结果；设备离线或检查超时不再被视为全部就绪。
- 检查 Apple 服务与驱动、USB 后端、接收组件、设备绑定、蓝牙环境、设备信任、开发者模式及所需无线同步设置。
- 新增只读驱动诊断与设备端设置检查；检查本身不安装驱动、不主动配对、不下载或挂载 DDI，也不发送控制输入。
- 可明确关闭 USB 控制、无线投屏/控制或蓝牙控制，相应检查项按“不需要”处理。
- 多设备按身份分别配置，新设备独立进入待配置列表；扫描不擅自删除旧绑定。
- 修复设置后只重新检查受影响的项目，按依赖进入下一项，不重复扫描无关硬件或逐页重放检查动画。
- 支持步骤跳过、返回、取消、关闭确认和断点保存；设置保存失败时保留当前步骤并显示错误。
- 已安装组件和已有设备绑定可直接复用；更改无线设置时按实际需要重新启动接收器。
- 保存逐设备画质偏好，包括有线显示、帧率和解码设置。
- 检查和汇总共用卡片与行控件，状态原位更新，减少阶段切换跳动；支持长列表、窗口尺寸变化及系统动画偏好。
- 设置期间暂停主窗口自动刷新，退出后恢复完整、精简或托盘模式。

## 二、新增本地自动化 API

- 在开发者工具中新增本地 Automation API，默认关闭，仅监听 `127.0.0.1`，默认端口为 17890。
- 提供设备列表、设备详情、连接与反控状态、能力和画面几何信息查询。
- 提供设备截图、点击、长按、按下/抬起、滑动、触摸路径、按键、文本输入及剪贴板读写接口。
- 提供离线 API 文档、OpenAPI 3.1 描述以及 Python、curl/PowerShell 示例。
- 使用 API Key 和细分权限；凭据采用当前 Windows 用户的 DPAPI 保护。
- 校验请求来源与 Host，限制请求速率、正文大小、路径点数、截图并发和连接数。
- 新增按设备排他的控制租约；支持续租、释放、到期回收，以及界面上的手动收回控制。
- 同一已绑定手机的 USB/AirPlay 身份共享控制所有权，多设备分别管理租约。
- API 输入与手动操作、键位映射、快捷键使用同一输入准入规则，避免互相抢占。
- 使用实际采集画面像素坐标与已有校准映射，画面尺寸、会话或校准变化后旧几何信息失效。
- 截图复用原生采集帧，编码移出 UI 线程；并发请求可共享同一编码任务。
- 桥接器新增剪贴板 RPC 能力；剪贴板读取不模拟复制键，纯写入不自动发送粘贴键。
- API 复用已建立的投屏和反控连接，不自动安装驱动、下载 DDI 或启动其他传输方式。
- 蓝牙 API 能力按实际键盘通道报告，不宣称支持绝对坐标触摸或任意 Unicode 剪贴板功能。

## 三、键盘、输入会话与重连修复

- USB/无线反控重新连接后恢复独立预览窗口的键盘路由与输入所有权。
- 自动更新 Windows 键盘钩子，修复钩子被系统静默移除后鼠标可用但键盘和快捷键失效的问题。
- 钩子恢复时同步修复按键录制和映射状态，清理漏收到的修饰键释放事件。
- 恢复时仍按住的按键保持隔离，直到实际松开，避免意外重复输入。
- 串行管理控制桥启动与停止，停止时取消尚未完成的启动，忽略旧进程的迟到输出和退出回调。
- 区分各次桥接会话的输入生命周期，旧会话的排队输入和剪贴板请求不能进入新会话。
- 修复排队输入取消、标准输入阻塞导致关闭卡住、进程复用和迟到回调问题。

name: foo-webview-default-theme
body: # Default Theme 0.2.0 ## 中文 这次更新围绕背景、歌词和窄窗口布局展开，并加入本地服务的准备与状态控制。 ### 背景与界面 - 新增随封面配色的流动背景，深浅模式可分别调节亮度、饱和度和磨砂效果。背景也可改为跟随强调色。 - 调整主视图、播放栏和右侧视图的背景层级，修正切歌、停止播放、缺少封面及退出沉浸视图时的闪烁与残留。 - 窄窗口中的左右浮层与文件夹、艺人、流派侧栏使用统一的间距和展开收起动效，修正菜单、重命名和按键关闭侧栏的问题。 - 右侧视图支持独立的前进与后退；设置中补充界面缩放、动效和沉浸视图的选项。 ### 歌词与播放 - 搜索结果显示更多歌词信息，并在来源提供时显示封面；可先预览候选歌词，再使用或设为曲目的默认歌词。 - 支持提前或延后歌词和重播当前句。可调整字体、译文和音译显示，以及不同类型歌词的优先级。 - 有时间轴歌词时，在进度条上悬停或拖动可查看目标位置附近的歌词；跳转和切歌时提供连续的进度反馈。 - 修正部分词源查询、候选信息和搜索页面返回时的状态恢复。 ### 兼容与稳定性 - 在 Windows 10 或窗口材质不可用时改用主题色背景；材质应用失败时显示提示。 - 更新日志跟随当前界面语言，播放统计的部分读取失败不再影响其他可用内容。 - 修正从托盘恢复后窗口再次收起的问题；窗口不可见时暂停相关背景和可视化任务。 - 新增本地服务的状态查看与重试入口。首次运行按需下载运行环境和服务文件，安装完成后可离线复用。服务未就绪不影响音乐播放和主题界面。 ### 从 0.1.0 更新 在 **设置 > 关于** 检查并安装主题更新，完成后重启 foobar2000。沿用现有模板目录和设置，无需先删除旧主题。 本版仍要求 **foo_ui_webview2 2.0.0 或更高版本**，以独立窗口运行；不支持 DUI 或 CUI 面板。本版发布时没有新的插件版本，主题也不会自动替换 foo_ui_webview2 或 foobar2000 本体。 首次安装使用完整主题安装包，解压后让 `index.html` 直接位于 `\webview-ui\<模板名>\` 内，再在插件首选项中选择该模板。`fe-*.zip`、后端包和运行时分块由更新器使用，不作为首次安装包。GitHub 的 `Source code` 归档是源码。 --- ## English This update focuses on backgrounds, lyrics and narrow-window layouts, and adds runtime preparation and status controls for the local service. ### Backgrounds and interface - Flowing backgrounds follow cover colors, with separate brightness, saturation and frosted-effect settings for light and dark modes. The background can also use your accent color instead. - Refined surfaces across the main view, player bars and right pane. Fixed background flashes and lingering images when changing tracks, stopping playback, displaying tracks without covers or leaving the immersive view. - Side overlays and folder, artist and genre sidebars use consistent spacing and transitions in narrow windows, with fixes for menus, renaming and keyboard dismissal. - T

name: vorssaint-utils
body:
### Summary
Dynamic Island now works on Macs and displays without a notch, on every display at once and on the Lock Screen. It adds a companion, Watch for any window, more AI agents, and new music, audio and calendar controls, while using much less battery. Window layout gets configurable snap areas, screenshots can go to the Shelf or a temporary link, and many bugs are fixed.

### Dynamic Island
- Floats as a capsule on Macs and displays without a notch, can show on every display at once and appears on the Lock Screen.
- A companion rests beside the camera, reacts to what happens and can carry the Command Bar out of the island. Settings → Dynamic Island → Companion.
- Watch turns part of any window, like a progress bar, into a live activity. Settings → Dynamic Island → Content → Watch.
- AI Agents adds OpenCode and GitHub Copilot, a choice of which limit to show and Codex banked resets.
- Music adds shuffle, hover controls, browser and video playback, and opens your music app when nothing plays. Controls add a microphone fader and a keyboard light slider.

name: MFGAdaUnlock-RenoDx
body:
# MFG Ada Unlock 1.4.3 — Continuous Border Stability

This update builds on 1.4.2 with smoother border-confidence transitions during diagonal movement. It targets abrupt changes near screen edges when motion crosses between horizontal and vertical dominance, particularly around 45 degrees.

### Image stability

- **Continuous border-axis blending.** Horizontal and vertical border treatments now blend smoothly, reducing sudden changes in border confidence as the motion direction changes.
- **Protected corners and native weighting.** Each axis retains its perpendicular-edge protection, structural candidate checks and native warp-weight anchor. The existing subpixel motion transition is preserved.
- **Local processing.** The active path uses Local Stable geometry and V2 Compatibility inpaint, without additional texture reads or confidence-history buffers.

### Documentation and build reporting

- Updated documentation describes the active release behavior and separates temporal-history research from the local path.
- Build manifests identify the variant, source and binary hashes, and embedded payload inputs for reproducible validation.

### Validation

All **32 automated tests passed**. The emitted border program passed **25,796 synthetic GPU cases in both motion directions**, with zero mismatches within the defined tolerance. Assembly and driver JIT validation retained **48 warp registers**; the geometry kernel remains at **40 registers**, with zero stack, spills or local memory.

Initial in-game feedback has been positive. Comparative FPS, frame-time and latency benchmarks are still pending; these checks do not establish a performance gain or universal artifact reduction.

### Installation

Close the game, replace the previous MFG Unlock addon, keep only one addon installed, and restart. Your existing configuration can be retained; no INI reset is required.

body:
**V1.4.2 adds more resilient detection for path-traced hair in The Witcher 3, which should help keep the mod working after game patches.** On the latest Witcher 3 update, where v1.4.1-hotfix.1 greyed out the Path Traced Hair option, path-traced hair is available again.

For The Witcher 3 DirectX 12, install RTXMFG as **`winmm.dll`** beside `witcher3.exe`. Enable HairWorks, path tracing and **Path Traced Hair** in the game. **Fully restart the game after changing Path Traced Hair or Frame Generation.** Hair support remains experimental and may stop working after a game patch; the menu's **Path traced hair** line shows when it is unavailable.

The ZIP contains only **RTXMFG.dll**, combining the backend and menu. For an existing single-DLL installation, close the game and replace the installed mod DLL, preserving its chosen filename and your settings. Press **Backspace** to open the menu. See the [README](https://github.com/dashdogy/RTX40MFG-Unlock/blob/v1.4.2/README.md) for installation and supported filenames. SHA-256 checksums for the ZIP and extracted DLL are attached.

**RTX 30 support remains very early and experimental.** The newer RTX 30 development changes are excluded from this release. Vulkan support remains experimental; Dynamic MFG is unavailable on Vulkan.

The release DLL passed all 54 local release regression cases (2,131 assertions), plus hair CPU checks and eight synthetic GPU configurations against two Witcher builds. Path-traced hair was confirmed in game on the latest update with a test build carrying the same hair code; this exact release DLL has not yet been run in game.

# Monica for Android 1.0.318

> 未发布 / Unreleased

## 中文

- 扩展常用信息输入建议：银行卡持卡人、证件及账单姓名共享已保存姓名，姓、名和中间名分别匹配；账单和证件地址支持街道、门牌、省市、邮编及国家建议，兼容独立卡包、密码内嵌内容及旧字段。保留签发机关建议，点击仅填写当前字段，不自动拆分姓名或修改其他资料。

- 修复 KDBX 密码批量删除缓慢及条目重新出现：密码页与密码库页统一按数据库一次保存，成功后整体更新列表；原生索引在后台以事务提交，拒绝过期快照。保存失败保留列表数据，不再逐条重试；外部文件完整写入后若校验失败，保留当前文件与恢复副本，避免覆盖另一会话的写入。

- 卡包的银行卡和证件编辑统一使用 M3E 内容卡片：新增内容以紧凑卡片展示，支持长按拖动及菜单排序，顺序随条目保存；扩展字段、自定义字段和账单地址改用相连的填充式编辑，缩小间距并适配键盘与大字体。隐藏字段使用密码键盘。

- 自动填充新增“保持解锁两分钟”设置，默认关闭；开启后同一应用及网站可复用验证，支持账号与密码分步填写及手动选择，连续填充不延长有效期。关闭此项、锁屏、手动锁定、移除 Monica 最近任务或进程重启均撤销临时授权。修复主应用清理后台后仍可恢复旧解锁会话的问题，自动填充操作不再延长主应用解锁时间；普通切换应用仍遵循自动锁定设置。

- 新增常用信息输入建议：银行名称、分行代码、客服电话、凭据分组标签、网站网址及证件签发机关可匹配已保存的同类值，点击即可填入；支持项目内嵌银行卡和证件，最多显示三项，锁定或不可访问的数据源不参与建议。

- 修复从其他应用接收 Passkey 时对空扩展和未启用支付扩展的过度拒绝，保留原始凭据及私钥；按验证码、无效数据、私钥及不支持的扩展显示跳过原因，诊断日志仅记录分类计数。含 PRF、Blob 或启用支付扩展的 Passkey 仍明确提示暂不支持，不丢弃扩展强行导入。

> **Codewhale** is the public product from Shannon Labs. The `codewhale`
> command, npm package, and release-asset names remain lowercase technical
> identifiers. The legacy npm package `deepseek-tui` is deprecated and
> receives no further releases. Users coming from v0.8.x legacy `deepseek` /
> `deepseek-tui` names should migrate with `docs/REBRAND.md`.

## Install

### Recommended — official GitHub release

New macOS/Linux install (checksummed binaries from this release):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://codewhale.net/install.sh | CODEWHALE_VERSION="v0.10.1" sh
"$HOME/.local/bin/codewhale" --version
```

For Windows, use the matching installer or archive below. For an existing
direct install, run `codewhale update`; it prints the executable path and
keeps newer builds. If the install directory is occupied by a different build,
use the fresh-directory migration in [the installation guide](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/CodeWhale/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md).

### Secondary packaging — npm and Cargo

```bash
npm install -g codewhale
# or build from source
cargo install codewhale-cli --locked
```

The wrapper downloads the matched `codewhale` and `codew` command assets
from this Release. Both contain the same compiled runtime.

### Docker / GHCR

```bash
docker run --rm -it \
  -e DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" \
  -v codewhale-home:/home/codewhale/.codewhale \
  ghcr.io/codewhale-hq/codewhale:v0.10.1
```

The image exposes the same runtime as both `codewhale` and `codew`. The
`latest` tag is also updated on release.

### Cargo (Linux / macOS)

```bash
cargo install codewhale-cli --locked
```

The Cargo package installs `codewhale`. Cargo cannot create a second command
alias from one binary target; users who want the shorter spelling can add a
`codew` symlink to that installed executable. The npm, Homebrew, archive,
shell-installer, and container channels install both command names directly.

> receives no further releases. Users coming from v0.8.x legacy `deepseek` /
> `deepseek-tui` names should migrate with `docs/REBRAND.md`.

## Install

### Recommended — official GitHub release

New macOS/Linux install (checksummed binaries from this release):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://codewhale.net/install.sh | CODEWHALE_VERSION="v0.10.1" sh
"$HOME/.local/bin/codewhale" --version
```

For Windows, use the matching installer or archive below. For an existing
direct install, run `codewhale update`; it prints the executable path and
keeps newer builds. If the install directory is occupied by a different build,
use the fresh-directory migration in [the installation guide](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/CodeWhale/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md).

### Secondary packaging — npm and Cargo

```bash
npm install -g codewhale
# or build from source
cargo install codewhale-cli --locked
```

The wrapper downloads the matched `codewhale` and `codew` command assets
from this Release. Both contain the same compiled runtime.

### Docker / GHCR

```bash
docker run --rm -it \
  -e DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" \
  -v codewhale-home:/home/codewhale/.codewhale \
  ghcr.io/codewhale-hq/codewhale:v0.10.1
```

The image exposes the same runtime as both `codewhale` and `codew`. The
`latest` tag is also updated on release.

### Cargo (Linux / macOS)

```bash
cargo install codewhale-cli --locked
```

The Cargo package installs `codewhale`. Cargo cannot create a second command
alias from one binary target; users who want the shorter spelling can add a
`codew` symlink to that installed executable. The npm, Homebrew, archive,
shell-installer, and container channels install both command names directly.

name: just-the-browser
body:
This update contains a fix for [CompatTelRunner.exe constantly crashing and restarting](https://github.com/corbindavenport/just-the-browser/issues/58) on some Windows PCs while reading Just the Browser's entries in the Windows Registry. **All Windows users should apply the fix to avoid background CPU usage.** Mac and Linux systems are not affected.

The fix is applied when performing any of these actions:
1. Starting the [Just the Browser installer](https://justthebrowser.com/), and then closing it after the menu loads
2. Updating or removing the configurations for each web browser in the installer
3. Manually installing the current `install.reg` or `uninstall.reg` files for [Chrome](https://justthebrowser.com/chrome), [Edge](https://justthebrowser.com/edge), [Firefox](https://justthebrowser.com/firefox), and [Brave](https://justthebrowser.com/brave)
4. Running these commands in a PowerShell window with Administrator permissions:

```powershell
Remove-Item -Path "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\JustTheBrowserChrome"
Remove-Item -Path "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\JustTheBrowserEdge"
Remove-Item -Path "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\JustTheBrowserFirefox"
Remove-Item -Path "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\JustTheBrowserBrave"
```

After the fix is applied, Just the Browser browser configurations will no longer appear in the "Installed apps" section of the Windows settings, or the "Add or Remove Programs" Control Panel. You can still update or remove the browser configurations with the Windows installer or registry files.

# v3.0.3

DSH Vision Router 3.0.3 is a corrective patch on the 3.0 line. It closes the three residuals
reported after 3.0.2 and carries two CI-action maintenance updates. There is no runtime dependency,
settings migration, Session-format change, public-API change or Host-support-window change.

## Highlights

- **Presented-image focus only reacts to fresh image results (#666).** Restoring a long Session no
  longer jumps to an old image below the viewport, and an empty `vision_present` result cannot
  steer the reader to another card. The helper receives the exact card node instead of querying
  the document for the last presented card.
- **The focus rule works across the supported Host window.** DSH 0.1.7+ exposes an explicit
  `phase`; the supported DSH 0.1.5 train does not. The client normalizes both contracts by using
  `phase` when present and falling back to the settled `block.kind === 'tool-result'`
  discriminant otherwise. Restored results initialize as already settled, while a live call still
  produces the non-result → result edge.
- **Leading-dot proxy hosts are no longer inert (#665).** `.example.com` now canonicalizes to the
  same apex-and-subdomain policy as `*.example.com`. Dot-boundary matching remains conservative,
  so lookalikes such as `evilexample.com` stay outside.
- **The exact DSH 0.1.7 browser smoke follows both presentation owners again (#664).** Changes to
  either presentation-boundary carrier now trigger the exact-Host browser regression layer.
- **CI action maintenance (#662, #663).** `actions/download-artifact` is pinned to v8.0.1, and the

MXC SDK v1.0.0 is the first stable release of the MXC SDK surface for Rust, .NET, and Node.js. It provides consistent APIs for creating and running containers, managing container lifecycles, selecting captured, piped, or terminal execution and discovering host support.

- NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@microsoft/mxc-sdk/v/1.0.0
- NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Mxc.Sdk
- crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/mxc-sdk/1.0.0

See the `Assets` section for `mxc-release-binaries.zip`, which contains signed binaries that can be useful for testing.

## What's New in v1.0.0

### The V1 SDK is stable

The supported public SDK is now available through explicit V1 entrypoints:

- Rust: `mxc_sdk::v1`
- .NET: `Microsoft.Mxc.Sdk.V1`
- Node.js: `@microsoft/mxc-sdk/v1`

The three SDKs share the same operation model and policy concepts while following the conventions of each language. V1 is the stable compatibility boundary for the 1.x release line. MXC will follow [semver 2.0](https://semver.org/) for future changes.

### Direct execution supports captured output, live pipes, and PTYs

Callers can choose the execution model that fits their application:

- **Run to completion** and receive captured stdout, stderr, warnings, metadata, and a typed outcome.
- **Spawn with pipes** and interact with separate stdin, stdout, and stderr streams through an SDK-owned process handle.
- **Spawn with a PTY** and interact through a caller-controlled terminal process, including initial terminal dimensions and runtime resize.

PTY support is available only when the selected backend can provide the requested terminal semantics.

###  Lifecycle managed APIs

The V1 lifecycle managed API supports:

- Provisioning a container and receiving an opaque `ContainerId`.
- Starting, stopping, and deprovisioning that container.
- Running, spawning, or opening a PTY-backed process inside an existing
  container when supported.

# foo_ui_webview2 v2.0.0

This is a major release with breaking changes; read **Upgrading from 1.x** before updating a theme. The final release of the 1.x series is [v1.14.0](https://github.com/NereaFantasia/foo_ui_webview2/releases/tag/v1.14.0). See the [changelog](https://nereafantasia.github.io/foo_ui_webview2/changelog) for the full list of changes.

Starting with this release, foo_ui_webview2 follows semantic versioning: the 2.x series will contain no further breaking changes. See [Versioning and compatibility](https://nereafantasia.github.io/foo_ui_webview2/reference/versioning).

## Upgrading from 1.x

- Calls with an undeclared parameter key, a value of the wrong type or a missing required value now fail with `INVALID_PARAMS`. Previously, extra keys were ignored.
- Only pages the host trusts can call the API; calls from other pages fail with `ORIGIN_DENIED`, and those pages receive no events. See [Which pages can call the API](https://nereafantasia.github.io/foo_ui_webview2/reference/security#which-pages-can-call-the-api).
- SDK methods now resolve with the host's envelope instead of a bare list or `null`, and no longer throw on failure. Read lists from the corresponding field, or use `unwrap`.
- SDK response types are now `XxxSuccess | ApiFailure`; check `success` before reading result fields (affects TypeScript only).
- Without a host, SDK calls resolve with a `NOT_SUPPORTED` failure instead of `{ mock: true }`.
- Track events no longer include `id` or `fullPath`; read `handle` instead.
- `library.getAlbumTracks` now takes the `name` and `albumArtist` of a `library.getAlbums` row.
- On a locked playlist, `library.addToPlaylist`, `queue.addPaths`, `playback.playPath` and `playback.playPaths` fail with `LOCKED`. Without an active playlist, `queue.add` fails with `NO_ACTIVE_ITEM`. Negative row numbers, and context menus whose `handles` are all unusable, fail with `INVALID_PARAMS`.
- File drops are accepted only where the page calls `preventDef

body:
-   **[Linux Wayland Rendering Freezes & Transparent Window Root Fix] Recognize GNOME Wayland Native Backend, Auto-Inject DMA-BUF Protection & Fix Visual Inversion (Fixes #3605, ref #3581)**:
    -   **Recognize GNOME Under Native Wayland**: Added `desktop_is_gnome` to `linux_graphics.rs`, keeping native Wayland alongside KDE and wlroots rather than erroneously forcing `GDK_BACKEND=x11` when an Xwayland DISPLAY is detected, eliminating WebKitGTK 2.44+ frame freezes and invisible surfaces on GNOME Wayland.
    -   **Auto-Inject WebKit DMA-BUF Protection**: Extended `should_disable_webkit_dmabuf` to encompass GNOME sessions, automatically setting `WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1` on Wayland to prevent driver buffer allocation conflicts and assertion failures between WebKitGTK and Mesa/GPU drivers.
    -   **Fix Inverted Transparent Window Workaround**: Corrected the check in `lib.rs` to inspect the effective GDK backend (`running_x11`), reliably stripping the window alpha channel under X11/Xwayland while preserving native Wayland compositing. (Thanks to @jeikl, Co-Authored-By: JeikCode)
-   **[agy CLI Keyring State Synchronization & End-to-End Account Verification] Fix Secret Service Collection Path, Prevent False Switches & Unify Web/Headless API (PR #3607)**:
    -   **Fix Linux secret-tool Collection Path**: Corrected `Some("login")` to the full D-Bus path `Some("/org/freedesktop/secrets/collection/login")`, complying with libsecret specifications and resolving persistent stale credential reads by agy.

body:
# Our Free Model v1.4.5

一次维护整合：地区受限与线路不稳的朋友等来了出口代理，同时修掉了一批报告集中的实际故障。

## 新增

- **出口代理（订阅 / 单代理）**——插件的上游请求现在可以走你自己的出口：机场订阅（自动拉起本机 mihomo、测速选最佳节点、踢除 429 节点）或单个 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理。设置页显示当前最佳节点与访问耗时；订阅地址按凭据对待，只在点「显示」时读取。升级/公告/EAC 车道不经出口，故障域隔离。
- **看板：号池负载面板 + 最近一回合**——号池面板显示容量、24h 活跃、进行中并发，畅通/繁忙/过载判定由网关进程实时给出，数字全部真实；「最近一回合」一行摘要，让刚发完消息的用户立刻看到 token 去向（#26）。

## 修复

- **EAC 签名车道加固**——签名后的请求体改走 Node 核心 http(s) 模块直发，`billion-context` 等改写 `fetch` 的本地插件不再碰得到签名字节；此前网关报「request signature rejected」被误诊为凭据失效，现在会明确提示是本地代理改写（#50）。
- **设置页连不上后端**——挂在反向代理子路径下的部署不再丢前缀；桌面端 `dsh-app://` 中继请求的准入兼容合并自社区 PR，准入异常转为 503 并输出固定字段诊断日志（#49/#54）。
- **截断自动续写**——回答撞到输出上限被截断时，插件会把已出正文回灌并自动续写一次，不再要你手动发「继续」（#28）。
- **网关默认单 IP 并发 20→5**——一条 LLM 流会占住上游连接几十秒到几分钟，旧默认让单个用户就能打满共享车道、拖垮整机（#55 现场之一）。

实测验证：本地网关与实机自检（对话/工具/视觉/更新链路）全绿。

全部 24 个离线套件通过，清单逐字节 Ed25519 重签。

## 升级

设置 → 插件升级，一键升级。

name: cc-switch
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.1

### 4.0 预览版的第一个修复版本

感谢大家对 4.0 预览版的试用和反馈。这个版本修复了 Gemini CLI 会话读不到、WSL 下 Codex 启动变慢等问题，也让 OpenCode 能用上思考档位。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.0-zh.md)。

> **预览版不会自动更新。** 应用内更新只跟随正式版，已经装了 4.0.0 的话，请在本页手动下载 4.0.1 安装。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.1-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.1-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

**OpenCode 可以选择思考档位了。** OpenCode 只会给标记为「支持推理」的模型提供思考档位（Ctrl+T），而 CC Switch 写入的自定义供应商以前从不带这个标记，所以通过 CC Switch 添加的模型一直选不了档位。现在，预设和获取到的模型只要已知支持推理（以预设或 models.dev 为准），就会自动标记，档位由 OpenCode 自己生成，跟随 OpenCode 的版本更新。

**「跳过 Claude Code 初次安装确认」有了说明。** 点开这一项的帮助图标，可以看到开关具体做了什么：在 `~/.claude.json` 里写入或删除 `hasCompletedOnboarding`。

## 修复

- **会话管理读不到 Gemini CLI 的会话。** 新版 Gemini CLI 把会话记录改成了 JSONL 格式，并会在恢复会话时把旧文件迁移过去，导致会话页看不到 Gemini 会话，用量同步也导入不到数据。现在完整支持新格式；旧文件和迁移后的新文件同时存在时只显示一份，删除时一起删掉。会话标题也会跳过 CLI 自动注入的上下文和斜杠命令。
- **WSL 下的 Codex 拖慢启动和会话扫描。** Codex 配置目录放在 WSL 里时，Windows 无法给其中的 SQLite 数据库加锁，每次都要等 5 秒超时。历史迁移因此每次启动都重来一遍，扫描会话也会卡住。现在会跳过这类数据库，会话标题改从会话索引读取。
- **上游拒绝请求，却被报成「输出达到上限」。** 有些 Responses 上游（比如 ChatGPT Codex 后端拒绝某个工具定义时）会在不处理请求的情况下返回「输出 token 达到上限」，用量全是 0，Claude Code 就提示了一个根本没碰到的上限。现在这种情况会如实报告为上游错误，并带上拒绝原因。
- **Codex 用量同步可能卡死。** 一个无关的异常之后，同步带父会话的 Codex 记录时可能卡住不动，现在已修复。
- **Grok Build 的「获取 API Key」打开的是官网首页。** 现在和其他应用一样，打开预设提供的注册页面。

## 体验改进

- **侧边栏收起和展开更流畅。** 动画改由合成层绘制，跟随屏幕刷新率，不再受限于 WebView 主线程的 60 帧。中途反向点击会从当前位置接着走。
- **侧边栏底部分隔线**和上方的分隔线样式统一，选中「用量统计」时不再贴着线。
- **重置次数的下拉箭头**单独占一行时，和上一行的倒计时时钟对齐。

## 构建与发布

macOS 两个架构改为并行编译，公证失败重试时不必从头编译；任何一个平台缺少更新签名时，构建会直接失败，不会再发布一个缺了某个平台的更新清单。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @allenxu09（Gemini CLI 会话、侧边栏动画与分隔线）和 @parkavenue9639（上游拒绝的错误报告）的贡献，感谢 @juntaosun 第一时间报告 Gemini CLI 会话的问题。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/v4.0.1/CHANGELOG.md)。

It brings ObtainX up to date by **syncing with upstream Obtainium [v1.6.17](https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/releases/tag/v1.6.17)** (thanks to @ImranR98 et al), covering everything Obtainium released since the last sync (v1.6.10).

- 📤 **Export your data first** (Backup → Export), and move the file to some other folder, just to be safe.
- 🔁 If anything behaves differently than it used to, it's most likely a **regression from the merge**. Please report it.

### ✨ New from Obtainium
- **Root installer**: installs updates silently through root (Settings → Integrations → Installer mode → Root). If root access is refused, your current mode stays.
- **Signing certificate check**: before installing, ObtainX checks that an update is signed with the same certificate as the app on your phone, and asks before installing one that isn't. It's on by default (Settings → Warnings).
- **Expected signing certificate hashes**: an optional per-app list, under the app's Additional options → Network, background & automation. An APK signed with any other certificate is never installed.
- **Certificate pinning**: opt-in, for GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg and RuStore (Settings → Source-specific).
- **Minimum age for updates**: holds back releases until they're a few days old (Settings → Updates, off by default). Each app can override it under Additional options → Tracking behavior.
- **Global APK filter regex**: one APK filter for every app that doesn't have its own (Settings → Updates).
- **Skip update/install confirmation dialog**: opt-in (Settings → Updates). Update all skips the update sheet and goes straight ahead with the apps the sheet would have selected.

body:
This release fixes some issues with offline sync, namely how it syncs progress back and handles multiple users. System language detection works better now and can be overridden in settings. Several other polish and bug fixes are also included, this release fixes a lot of "v3 contacts reality" issues my manual testing missed.

Changes:
- Server connection issues are handled better and can be retried.
  - You can now log in a server that lost its login.
  - If the server drops video playback, a clear error is now shown.
- Re-work offline progress sync
  - Offline sync actually reliably syncs progress including manual watch/unwatch
  - Multiple users using the offline catalog is now handled properly
  - Fixed and properly tested download folder moving
- The deeper UI updates now when state changes elsewhere, not just the homepage.
- Fixed numerous playback bugs
  - Fixed video resume sometimes breaking playback position (#761, #765)
  - Fixed issue where HDR gets disabled (#771)
  - Fixed video playing while it is still loading (#785)
  - Fixed closing external mpv not stopping the application
  - Opening the application while playing now just raises the window
  - Fullscreen in browser now implies player fullscreen
- Fix numerous library issues
  - Fixed intermittent blank library page on film ending
  - Library sort is now remembered between visits
  - Metadata refresh option added (#764)
  - Missing episodes are now marked and don't get play attempts
  - Added shuffle and description to season pages
  - Fix rounded tiles on Nebula/Purple Haze theme (#777)
  - Prevented homepage flickering for HiDPI/many library users
- Improved server/profiles system
  - Added server discovery (#755)
  - You can select the offline catalog as a separate server while online
  - Fixed newlines being pasted into login forms
  - Slow/unreachable servers now better handled when switching servers/profiles
  - Quick connect can be retried/cancelled

name: oh-my-openagent
body:
**Code mode can install JavaScript packages per session.** 5.1.19 runs on senpi 2026.10.10. A cell that is only `%bun add <package ...>` or `%npm add <package ...>` installs packages into the session's own managed environment without restarting the kernel, and the next cell imports them. The project's `package.json` and `node_modules` are untouched and package scripts never run. ([senpi 2026.10.10](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.10))

### Added

**A Python cell's `@tool` functions can be granted to a task child**, the same way JavaScript `tool(fn)` tools already were. ([#9529](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9529))

### Changed

**An idle gateway store gives back its worker thread.** After 60 seconds with no store call in flight, the worker is retired, and the next call starts a fresh one with its registrations restored. That frees about 2.9 MB per terminal control endpoint. ([#9592](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9592))

**omo runs on senpi 2026.10.10.** It warns when a requested thinking level isn't available instead of dropping it, keeps project rule discovery inside the project on Windows, and keeps the resident Claude subscription session receiving only new messages when `compaction.model` is set. Code mode also gets opt-in isolated cells (`isolate: true` with `sandbox.enabled`). Full list: [senpi 2026.10.10](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.10).

Thanks to @Dante-dan for the manifesto reveal fixes on the site ([#9586](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9586)) and a test-fixture fix ([#9599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9599)).

body:
Review and audit findings are numbered now, so you can answer "fix 2 and 4" instead of quoting lines back. CodeBuddy runs ponytail through the existing Claude plugin, and `/ponytail-gain` shows the honest agentic benchmark averages (54% less code, 22% fewer tokens, 20% lower cost, 27% faster, safety kept) instead of the old single-shot numbers a chatty baseline inflated. name: readest
body:
## Release Highlights
* Text-to-Speech: You can now listen sentence by sentence and loop a passage with A-B repeat, control playback from your desktop's Now Playing controls
* Reading: Added dialogue highlighting for quoted speech, a Column Gap setting for two-page spreads
* Sync: Added a Readest plugin for CrossPoint e-readers for reading progress sync
* Sync: You can now sync reading progress to Pagebound, sign in to Hardcover more easily, and note edits are no longer overwritten by older synced copies
* PDF: PDFs now blend smoothly with your reading theme with smart image inversion, show page thumbnails in the table of contents
* PDF: Highlighting and text selection on scanned PDFs is smoother and more accurate, and very large scanned pages no longer crash the reader on iOS
* Translation: You can now add your own translation providers with a reusable prompt library, look up words with an AI context dictionary
* Annotations: A global note now appears on every occurrence of its text, exports can include the sentence around each highlight
* Android: Added home screen widgets for your current book and bookshelf, automatic e-ink full refresh every few page turns
* More: Images now have a long-press and right-click menu to copy or save them, Windows shows PDF thumbnails in Explorer

## What's Changed
* fix(koplugin): fix sync on Android, library pull ANR, and Rescan library by @chrox in https://github.com/readest/readest/pull/6364
* chore(agent): add koreader-e2e skill for on-device plugin testing by @chrox in https://github.com/readest/readest/pull/6366
* fix(reader): fall back to saving a file when the gallery save fails by @chrox in https://github.com/readest/readest/pull/6367
* fix(windows): drop the broken native shadow on Windows 10 by @k6G52m4Dz75W in https://github.com/readest/readest/pull/6362

[添加] 蓝雪女仆品牌动效抽离为独立 brand-motion 共享模块，统一管理角色资源与打包校验脚本；安装包内不再内嵌静态占位图
[添加] 播放会话增强：新增播放失败原因分类（网络、解码、音频、鉴权、限制、源）与恢复阶段上报，支持音轨列表与音质、音轨语言选择
[添加] 离线播放错误策略：离线视频播放失败时按原因给出可操作的恢复建议
[更改] 聊天消息时间线、动态多账号缓存、首页加载序列等逻辑抽为独立策略类并补充单元测试
[修复] 播放器错误恢复策略与播放页状态同步问题；避免离线播放器重复加载
[修复] 投票卡片不再为底部播放栏预留安全区（对齐官方客户端实现）：卡片按整个视频视口定位与限高，不再被压短后只能内部滚动、截断末尾选项与状态行。
[优化] 投票卡片投票后展示各选项实时占比并高亮自己的选择（对齐官方客户端，移除底部“✓ 已投票”文字提示），提交中保持“投票提交中…”提示；选中项改用当前配色的浅色容器（蓝色配色即浅蓝，primaryContainer + onPrimaryContainer 文字），未选中项保持半透明白，高亮对比明显。
[优化] 收紧播放底栏下方与左右留白：手机档底栏底部间距 8→4dp、左右间距 12→6dp，进度条触摸容器高度 20→12dp（平板/超宽档同步收紧）；全屏进度条与分P分段条的左右内缩改为跟随底栏留白，互动卡片避让尺寸同步更新。
[调整] 普通视频、番剧、离线视频及直播弹幕统一按系统显示密度换算字号与描边，不再跟随应用内界面缩放或显示大小微调；内嵌/竖屏基础字号为 15dp，全屏为 18dp，保留用户字号倍率与服务端字号等级，移除竖屏沉浸播放器额外的 1.18 倍字号放大。描边粗细改以 dp 设置，默认 1.5dp；全屏切换重新测量已保留弹幕，不因字号分档清空时间线。
[修复] 互动卡片（投票、评分、三连、UP/链接）拦截整卡点击，不再穿透到播放器的单击/双击手势：在卡片上点按不再误唤出控制栏，在卡片上双击不再误触发播放/暂停导致进度条停住；卡片自身的选项、星位与关闭按钮仍照常响应。
[优化] 底栏“字幕/更多”等文字按钮的上下 padding 统一为 2dp，不再随窗口宽度分档；时间、音质、画质、倍速等单行文字显式收紧行高，减少上下留白，保持字号、图标与卡片定位不变。
[优化] 底部播放栏收紧播放、弹幕及全屏图标、时间与操作文字字号、输入区行高和底部间距；音质按钮不再强制撑到 48dp，局部图标按钮按播放槽位测量，保留原生触摸扩展。互动卡片安全区同步采用收紧后的播放栏尺寸。
[修复] 卡片定位安全区遵循实际进度条位置：内嵌播放器的贴底进度条不再额外扣除默认底部 padding，避免卡片被多余空白上推。
[修复] 互动卡片定位永久排除底部控制栏安全区域，控制栏隐藏时仍保留同一范围；服务端右下角坐标映射到安全区域右下角，黑边仅扣除实际相交部分。全屏导航栏采用不受显隐影响的安全区，避免控制栏显隐时卡片位移。
[修复] 投票和评分卡片主体分别固定为 130dp 与 180dp，关闭按钮另留 14dp；全屏不再按播放器宽度拉长，仅在窄视口放不下时收缩。
[修复] 投票与评分卡片采用服务端 duration，不再统一延长到 8 秒，避免评分卡片残留到后续三连卡片出现时造成重叠；显示窗口采用左闭右开边界，到结束时刻立即退出，暂停和回拖均按当前播放进度计算。
[优化] 三连弹幕补齐官方客户端风格的“仅三连”和“三连加关注”卡片：半透明黑色横条、白色点赞与收藏图标、实心币图标和独立粉色关注按钮，移除三连卡片的额外关闭按钮及原生按钮高度占位。三连与关注分别触发操作，已关注时三连仍可使用，大字号关注文字保持可见。
[修复] 关注与三连弹幕采用服务端 duration 和 posX_2/posY_2 百分比坐标，并在播放器视口内保留边距、裁限位置；兼容旧坐标字段，避免参考视频 00:24 的卡片被固定 3 秒时长提前隐藏。
[添加] 评分弹幕按官方客户端截图展示未评分与结果态：横向半透明黑底卡片、白色空心星、真实参与人数，评分确认后显示金色星与黄色平均分，关闭按钮位于卡片外侧。参与人数、平均分与既有个人评分读取弹幕元数据中的 count、avg_score、mid_score；提交成功后重新查询统计，不以个人评分推算平均分。
[修复] 真实投票弹幕正确解析 idx/desc 选项及 my_vote，提交使用服务端的一基选项编号而非数组下标；缺少选项时在卡片内查询投票详情，选项、加载

This hotfix bundles [Aria2 Next 2.8.6](https://github.com/AnInsomniacy/aria2-next/releases/tag/v2.8.6) across all six desktop targets to restore Windows downloads affected in 4.0.1-beta.2 and 4.0.1-beta.3.

body:
### Minor Changes

- [#1120](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1120) [`2aecca1`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/2aecca12ea9ff047f76c8178cb64dfeafd192abe) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - Graduate **`implement-spec`** into the **Engineering** bucket, so it ships in the Claude Code plugin, gets a docs page, and is routed by `ask-matt` as the parallel alternative to per-ticket `implement`.

  `implement-spec` (user-invoked) implements a whole spec in one run. It reads the tickets as a **task graph**, runs implementer subagents in their own worktrees across the ready **frontier**, and lands everything on one **integration branch**, closing out with `code-review`. Ahead of graduating:

  - The goal is now the integration branch, not a PR. A draft PR opens only when the issue tracker closes work through PRs or you ask for one, and only after the first merge (a branch with no commits ahead of main can't open one). Without a PR, the tickets are resolved the way the tracker closes work.
  - It points at the issue tracker like its siblings, telling you to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` when none has been provided, rather than silently defaulting to `gh`.
  - Each implementer confirms its worktree is based on the integration branch, builds its ticket with `tdd`, and merges the integration tip into its own branch before reporting done, so each merge is a fast-forward.

- [#1120](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1120) [`2aecca1`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/2aecca12ea9ff047f76c8178cb64dfeafd192abe) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - Graduate **`pr`** into the **Engineering** bucket, so it ships in the Claude Code plugin, gets a docs page, and is routed by `ask-matt` as the PR-body close-out.

name: HandheldCompanion
body:
This update addresses several long-standing issues in the virtual controller stack, improves application shutdown so devices and managers can close cleanly, and includes fixes for library names, controller recovery, AYANEO devices and navigation state.

## Highlights
### A more reliable virtual controller stack
USB/IP and VIIPER handling has been reworked to resolve known virtual-controller status and attachment issues. Device transitions are now validated more carefully, failed operations are rolled back, and updates can handle both older and newer USBIPWin2 installations.

More details are available in the [[USBIP & VIIPER – Virtual controller status](https://www.patreon.com/handheldcompanion/posts/usbip-viiper-170455986)](https://www.patreon.com/handheldcompanion/posts/usbip-viiper-170455986) post.

### Improved shutdown operation
Shutdown now gives device and manager cleanup enough time to complete gracefully. VirtualManager asynchronous operations no longer block or fail during application close, allowing connected devices to be closed properly and preventing shutdown from ending in a crash or leaving background managers running.

### Cleaner library names and better device recovery
Library titles are now cleaned up by removing common metadata, suffixes and version markers. Controller recovery is also better synchronized during startup and power-cycle events, with additional fixes for AYANEO RGB, SuperJoy and Flip devices.

# What Changed
## Virtual controller stack
- Improved USB/IP compatibility across older and newer USBIPWin2 versions.
- Updated the bundled USB/IP installer to version 0.9.8.1.
- Deferred legacy USB/IP updates until after a restart when required, then resumed installation through Windows RunOnce.
- Improved installer restart messaging, scheduled-task handling and file-copy behavior.

name: snow-apps
body:
# Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.2.2

## 更新内容

- **设置更好找**：按功能整理设置，相关选项可直接跳转，侧边栏随时可搜索；支持调整应用字体大小。
- **文字识别更灵活**：可选择“精度优先”或“速度优先”，并通过智能排版设置按文字布局整理识别结果。
- **翻译更省操作（Snow Shot）**：设置主要和次要目标语言，主要语言的文本译为次要语言，其他文本译为主要语言。
- **长截图更方便**：新增滚动截图设置对话框，可集中调整捕获选项。
- **Windows 更新更清楚**：显示更新进度，可在下次启动时安装已下载的更新。
- **日常使用更流畅**：减少大图的内存开销，改善设置、历史记录和贴图操作；修复撤销/重做快捷键、删除标注后的序号同步，以及工具栏弹窗与取色器相互干扰的问题。

两款应用均提供 Windows x64 和 macOS 15+ Apple Silicon 安装包。Mini 包含适用的截图、OCR、设置与性能改进；翻译功能仅适用于 Snow Shot。

## What's new

- **Easier settings:** preferences are grouped by feature, related settings link to each other, and search is always available in the sidebar. Adjust the application's font size for more comfortable reading.
- **Better text recognition:** choose Accuracy First or Speed First, and use Smart Typesetting to organize recognized text according to its layout.
- **More convenient translation (Snow Shot):** set primary and secondary target languages. Text already in your primary language translates into the secondary language; other text translates into the primary language.
- **Scrolling screenshots:** open a dedicated settings dialog to adjust scrolling capture options.
- **Clearer Windows updates:** see update progress and apply downloaded updates on the next launch.
- **Smoother everyday use:** reduced memory overhead for large images and faster settings, history, and pinned-window operations. Fixed undo/redo shortcut handling, serial-number synchronization after deleting annotations, and color-picker interference with toolbar popups.

Available for Windows x64 and Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later. Snow Shot Mini includes the applicable screenshot, OCR, settings, and performance improvements; translation remains a Snow Shot feature.

## Install on macOS

Run this in Terminal as your normal user:

```sh
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh 'https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.2.2_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh' && b

name: CopyQ
body:
## Added

- Adds support for GNOME 50 (#3677).

## Changed

- Tab data and state files are moved to XDG-compliant directories,
  `%LOCALAPPDATA%` on Windows and `~/Library/Application Support` on macOS
  (#3692, #3693). State path can be changed using `COPYQ_STATE_PATH`
  environment variable.

  **Important**: This is backwards incompatible. The data and state files are
  moved when the new app version starts. Older versions of the app will not see
  these files and basically lose all items.

- FakeVim is updated from upstream repository.

## Fixed

- Fixes audio engine always using a small amount of CPU and indicating (on KDE)
  that it plays audio (#3684). The engine is initialized only when needed and
  released after it stops playing all audio.

- Fixes initial script dialog size (#3700). Thanks to @wyf-777.

- Fixes slow tab icon lookups when the app contains many item tabs (#3721).
  Thanks to @jkindrix (Justin Kindrix).

- Fixes keeping old tabs in configuration (#3722). Thanks to @sakashimaa.

- Windows: Prevents app from attempting (unsuccessfully) to paste to windows
  the user cannot switch back to (#2556). Thanks to @ntzb.

- Wayland: Fixes global shortcuts failing when portal service starts later or
  restarts (#3616, #3680).

- Wayland: Fixes global shortcuts in non-default sessions (#3713).

- Wayland: Fixes rebinding global shortcuts on start (#3678).
  Thanks to @Memoraike (Meow).

- Synchronize plugin: Fixes GUI freeze when removing items and on startup and
  retrying to remove absent files (#3629, #3697).

name: dsh-vision-router
body:
# v3.0.1

DSH Vision Router 3.0.1 is a corrective release on the 3.0 line. It ships the five
consumer-visible fixes that were merged after v3.0.0 was tagged: two in the Desktop
settings surface and three in the provider egress paths, where a configured `proxy` /
`proxyHosts` must reach every leg that talks to a provider. There are no new peers, no
settings migration, no Session format change and no public API change.

## Highlights

- **Desktop settings values (#619).** A Host that exposes a legacy-shaped
  `settingsScope` can return an empty `vision-router` namespace while its native config
  forms keep working. That scope is now kept only as the delegate for every other
  namespace instead of bypassing the local settings bridge, so the Vision Router
  settings surface reads and writes real values on the Desktop shell.
- **Model picker catalog (#620).** The model-visibility boundary now patches every
  loader instance it can reach — including one published after the boundary installs —
  so the picker no longer groups the same model twice.
- **Background and local provider legs (#623).** The Router-owned provider transport is
  threaded into the local vision stabilizer, the host/security boundaries and the
  background benchmark, so those legs honor `proxy` / `proxyHosts` exactly like
  foreground vision turns.
- **Connection probe egress (#633).** The settings "test connection" probe now takes the
  Router-owned transport (`runtime.providerTransport`) instead of relying on the legacy
  configured-pair scope, which by construction cannot cover a `vision-http` direct
  backend — the plugin's default shape. The legacy boundary fetch stays as the fallback
  for Hosts that only configure the legacy scope.
- **LM Studio native transport (#634).** `callLocalBackend`'s `format: 'lmstudio'`

name: desktop
body:
# Zen Stable Release
Introducing Library! A better place to organize and access your history, media, downloads, spaces and more.

## Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-97/

## New Features
- Introducing Library! A better place to organize and access your history, media, downloads, spaces and more.
- You can now resize the sidebar even when its hidden. If the sidebar is resized too small, it will automatically hide itself.
- Updated to Firefox 157.0
- WebRTC video calls can now use hardware AV1 decoding on devices that support it, instead of always decoding AV1 video in software.

## Fixes
- Significant performance improvements on startups/new windows when there are lots of tabs open.
- Certain icon animations like the boost indicator or musical notes on the sidebar are now more performant. ([#15299](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/15299))
- Fixed status panel and glance controls not using the correct theme colors. ([#15280](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/15280))
- Fixed some HDR videos encoded in 8-bit color formats looking dull and gray on Windows instead of displaying in HDR.
- Improved audio and video synchronization when repeatedly changing the playback speed of videos, for example on YouTube.
- Fixed an issue on Windows where making a video full screen would leave the Windows taskbar showing over the video.

## Changes
- When a link gets routed to a specific space, it will prioritize the window that has that space open.
- Some elements like the sidebar and the command bar now appear with blur effects.
- On MacOS, buttons at the bottom of the sidebar now appear larger.
- Swiping to the right on the last space will now try to create a new space.
- When the sidebar is at the right, the buttons at the bottom are now reversed.

name: Mole
body:
Mole

Deep clean and optimize your Mac.

### Changelog 1. **More reliable app uninstall**: Verified internal Time Machine snapshot folders no longer prevent app-copy checks from finishing, background items stay tied to the selected app, and retained-file reasons, Finder permission refusals, and reclaimed-space totals are reported more accurately. 2. **Clean protects renv and uncertain app caches**: Saved whitelists no longer weaken renv protection, app caches stay untouched when running state is unknown, and a read-only probe timeout does not stop unrelated cleanup. 3. **Purge spends less time waiting on slow checks**: A single slow activity check no longer holds up the whole batch, cancellation stops background checks, and filtering failures no longer repeat discovery. 4. **Analyze refreshes changed sizes**: After deletion or a directory refresh, Analyze updates affected folder and overview totals instead of restoring outdated sizes from earlier scans. 5. **Status handles VPN traffic and partial JSON**: Network totals use the active default-route tunnel without counting its carrier twice, and `mo status --json` preserves usable measurements when one collector fails. 6. **Developer space and cache cleanup**: FVM Flutter SDKs and Codex worktrees get read-only size rows, worktree listings avoid duplicates, and VS Code and Cursor extension download caches are cleaned again. 7. **History separates simultaneous commands**: Overlapping runs of different commands keep their own operations and totals instead of mixing into one history entry. 8. **Clearer terminal progress**: Loading uses a centered 2×2 shape, real cleanup results use the same capacity colors as previews, and the installer spinner no longer stops unexpectedly. ### 更新日志 1. **卸载残留处理更准确**：检查 app 副本时，不再被已确认的 Tim

### 简要

- 新增统一数据库原始信息管理器，根目录按 Monica 本地、MDBX、KeePass 分组；支持独立双栏、滑动多选和跨栏批量复制／移动，快照采用统一文件夹浏览布局。

- 开发者设置改为 M3E 连续分组布局；日志改为独立页面，支持搜索、来源与级别筛选、连续日志阅读和完整报告分享。日志正文改为连续等宽文本，保留筛选和长按复制；清空日志与查看日志并列，提示先清空、复现再分享，并移除旧自动填充 V2 测试入口。

- 密码项目支持通过“添加内容”增加多组账号密码，每组独立管理多密码与验证器，详情和自动填充按账号区分；批量添加仍创建独立项目。#151 安全分析统一显示在全部凭据和添加内容之后，不再插入账号分组之间。

- 修复密码附加内容编辑弹窗随底层卡片回收而意外消失、重建的问题，保留未保存草稿。

- 密码库概览、验证器和通行密钥页的右上角菜单新增“扫描通行密钥二维码”，复用密码页扫码流程。

- 通行密钥移动遇到跳过或失败时，弹窗逐项说明原因和处理建议，修正成功数量文案。

- 银行卡号码字段统一显示为“卡号”，避免借记卡误标为信用卡。

- 修复使用 32 字节 KeePass 密钥文件时原始密钥被修改，影响再次打开或密钥副本的问题。

- Monica 本地新增主密码恢复保护；设备安全密钥失效时保留原数据，使用已准备的加密恢复材料尝试恢复。
- 修复全量备份的归档密码遗漏、账单地址与支付账户类型误判、密码历史和回收站恢复问题。

- 修复 Android 12 等系统打开自动填充选择页时丢失目标表单信息的问题。

- 自动填充与 Monica 键盘支持密码内的银行卡、账单地址和证件副本；键盘补齐独立账单地址。

- Monica 键盘支持填写密码项目的自定义字段，横向滚动操作按钮，避免列表拥挤。#149

- 统一生成器常用建议高度，修复横向滚动时页面上下跳动。

- 快捷筛选新增 API Key、API 令牌和 GPG 密钥，同时匹配独立项目与密码内嵌内容。
- 银行卡、证件类型菜单统一为紧凑圆角样式，清晰显示当前选项。

- 统一各页筛选菜单，保留标签和类型差异，优化布局、拖拽及应用内缩放。

- 修复密码内的验证器密钥暂时不可读时从验证器列表消失的问题。
- 修复相同绑定账号下，密钥相同但 PIN 不同的 mOTP 验证器被误合并显示的问题。

### 详细

- **数据库原始信息与快照：** 选中 MDBX／KeePass 后，可从各列表右上角直接进入管理器。两栏可分别选择数据库、文件夹和搜索条件，横纵滚动与选择互不影响；支持长按滑动多选、新建与重命名文件夹、条目重命名及向另一栏复制／移动。双栏收紧文字与间距，保留大字体可读性。MDBX 同格式复制保留未知结构与附件，KeePass 同格式传送保留原生字段与文件夹属性；跨格式传送先验证字段、附件与源版本，再移除源项目，无法完整转换时逐项提示并保留源数据，目标可能保留未完成副本。修复笔记正文与备注转入 KeePass 时的分别保存，并按文件名识别附件类型。原始字段按需读取、默认隐藏，MDBX 原始字段保持只读。快照保留独立横屏对照及原有恢复／删除确认，不更改数据库格式。

- **开发者诊断：** 复用设置页的紧凑分组组件，保留验证、兼容性与同步诊断选项。日志页同时展示系统及各持久化来源，修复系统日志存在时其他来源无法查看的问题；搜索保留整条异常上下文，连续等宽正文支持长按复制、刷新及完整文件分享。后台加载与筛选、长文本分段按需渲染减少界面阻塞，旋转保留筛选与日志快照；清除日志需确认，仅处理诊断日志，不清除密码库或配置。

- **MDBX 密码正文边界：** 修复导入密码以密文标记开头时被重复解密而导入失败的问题；明确新写入的密码正文，避免后续旧数据修复误改密码，同时保留旧格式嵌套加密迁移。
- **项目内多账号：** 新增内联账号组，支持独立用户名、多密码、验证器密钥及验证码预览；密码强度显示在字段内部，组间留白与组内连续圆角分开处理。账号、所有密码与验证器在编辑和详情中连续分组；添加密码位于验证码预览下方，新增密码插在验证器之前，详情账号密码使用紧凑横向布局，保留复制和显隐，点击内容可在触点附近打开操作菜单；详情验证码省略重复图标与名称，密码行根据实际读取结果显示，避免轻量列表数据导致附加账号密码被隐藏。系统自动填充和 Monica 键盘使用选中的真实密码记录，键盘填写前重新读取以避免过期数据。分组标识随本地、MDBX、KeePass、Bitwarden 与全量备份保存

name: MFGAdaUnlock-RenoDx
body:
## Local Low-Overhead Update

This update removes the experimental confidence-history backend and returns inpaint to **V2 Compatibility**, while retaining the established local Adaptive Quality V3 improvements.

### Why was Inpaint V3 removed?

Recent testing did not show a consistent visual benefit sufficient to justify its additional complexity. The confidence-history backend also failed activation checks in reported sessions, so installing a Temporal cubin did not guarantee temporal stabilization was actually running. This release returns to V2 Compatibility and removes the experimental history backend, prioritizing reliability and lower processing overhead while preserving the established local V3 quality improvements.

### What changed

- **Inpaint V3 removed from the active path.** Inpaint now uses V2 Compatibility, with the existing V1/native safety fallbacks.
- **Geometry uses the dedicated V3.1 Local Stable cubin**, without temporal confidence history. Its local silhouette and directional-support improvements remain enabled under the V3 profile.
- **No CUDA/NVAPI temporal launch interception**, history allocations, GPU self-tests, private phase modules or backend synchronization barriers.
- Saved temporal geometry and inpaint settings are ignored in this build without rewriting your configuration. Temporal controls are replaced with a clear explanation in the UI.
- Diagnostics explicitly show that the confidence-history backend is disabled. A temporal hook fast path is no longer needed because these launch hooks are not installed.

### What stays the same

- V3 luminance/chroma validation, directional borders, local oriented geometry and provider-native scatter.
- Existing MFG multiplier controls and non-temporal compatibility paths.
- Reflex, FPS caps and pacing settings; no automatic pacing override is introduced.
- Exact V3 provider validation for **DLSS-G 310.9.0 and 310.9.1**. Unknown providers receive no V3 patches.

### Validation and limitations

name: Magpie
body:
# Magpie Experimental v0.6.9

本版更新了帧率与刷新设置、工具栏操作、DLSSNR 细节控制和效果器说明，并新增五个 xBR 效果。

## 功能更新

### Magpie 本体易用性更新

#### 帧率与刷新

- 默认配置和应用配置现在统一使用 **“帧率与刷新”**，可在同一处调整内容帧率、节奏控制、光标刷新和空闲重绘。主页提供默认配置的摘要与编辑入口。
- 内容帧率支持 **跟随源／自动／自定义**，节奏控制支持 **Front Edge／Async／NVIDIA Reflex**。自动模式根据显示器刷新率和补帧倍率选择基础目标；跟随源模式按源内容的更新节奏处理。
- 光标刷新支持 **响应优先／仅随原始内容帧／原始帧优先并补充**。补充刷新率可自动跟随显示器，也可自定义最低目标；光标状态变化时按设置补充刷新。
- 内容、光标和空闲重绘的手动值统一为 **15–360 FPS、整数、步进 1**。新配置和恢复默认使用以下设置，已有有效设置会保留。

| 设置 | 新配置默认值 |
| --- | --- |
| 内容帧率 | 自定义 60 FPS |
| 节奏控制 | Front Edge |
| 光标刷新 | 原始帧优先并补充，最低 60 FPS |
| 空闲持续重绘 | 开启，30 FPS |

- 空闲重绘位于默认折叠的高级选项中，实际帧率受内容上限限制；开启补帧后暂停空闲重绘，但保留设置。
- 改进 Reflex 的节奏控制，以及 Front Edge 模式下低内容帧率时的光标补充刷新。
- 设置自动保存，重新启用缩放后生效；缩放时也可在参数面板中调整并选择“保存并重启”。新建应用配置复制默认配置或所选模板，之后可独立调整。

#### 效果组操作

- 恢复列表下方的 **“＋新建效果组”** 按钮。
- 右上角 **“其他选项”** 集中提供导入、导出、配置文件夹和重置，按钮的文字与留白更协调。
- “配置文件夹”可直接打开当前使用的设置目录；重置仍需确认。

#### 清除快捷键

- 快捷键设置增加清除按钮，编辑弹窗支持保存、清除和取消。A
- 清除后显示“未设置”，重启后仍保持；需要时可重新设置。修复快捷键相关的启动问题。

#### 工具栏拖动与显示

- 按住工具栏 **空白或 FPS 区域** 即可拖动，可停靠在顶部或底部，也可沿边缘左右移动。
- 靠近画面水平中心时自动吸附，并显示对齐提示。
- 上下停靠位置按配置和窗口／全屏模式保存；左右位置仅在本次运行保留，下次重新居中。
- 调整按钮、图标和 FPS 的对齐；底部停靠时，菜单和提示向画面内展开。

#### 参数窗口与主页

- 效果器参数窗口可使用主窗口之外的屏幕空间，内容较多时可滚动，减少拥挤和遮挡。
- DLSSNR 按细节控制、进阶调整和各 Pass 分组显示。进阶调整默认隐藏，收起后仍保留参数与效果；悬停效果名称可查看简短说明。
- 全局重复帧检测移至 **帧率与刷新 → 高级选项**；补帧效果的重复帧过滤仍在各自参数中设置。开发者选项入口保留在主页。

#### 效果器选择说明

- 更新全部 **162 项内置效果器**的中英文说明，帮助了解用途、适合素材、变体差异、效果链位置和使用限制。
- 分类和推荐标签更清楚，旧配置与搜索名称保持兼容。推荐标签帮助按用途选择效果。

#### 虚拟显示环境下的显卡选择

- 修正 Sunshine 等虚拟显示环境中误选显示设备进行渲染的问题。

### 效果器更新

#### 五个 xBR 效果

新增 **xBR 2x、xBR 3x、xBR 4x、xBR NoBlend 3x、xBR Hybrid 2x**，适合像素画和低分辨率 2D 内容，可按所需倍率和边缘风格选择。

#### DLSSNR Multi Pass

- 改进多 Pass 与输入分辨率调整的处理，减少重复工作；仍支持 **1／2／3 次处理**，默认 1 次，各 Pass 可独立调整 NR 参数。
- 细节控制统一作用于全部 Pass 完成后的整体修正，调整多层效果时更容易控制最终观感。

#### DLSSNR 细节控制

- 简化颜色与细节参数，统一提供总强度、色度强度、明度总强度、阴影／结构强度和高光／辉光强度。
- 进阶调整提供色相／暗部／高光保护、过度修正抑制、低频／高频修正强度和诊断视图。默认隐藏，展开、收起均保留参数。

| 参数 | 范围 | 默认值与调整方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 五项基础

name: Folo
body:
# What's New in v0.5.11

## Improvements

- Text-to-speech starts reliably on long articles, and stopping it or switching articles no longer leaves audio playing in the background
- The player bar now also shows on article and folder screens on iPad, Android and iOS before 26, so text-to-speech can be paused or stopped there
- Settings sync covers every appearance, general and AI setting again; only device-specific ones such as the interface language stay on each device
- The action language now syncs, so AI chat answers in the language you picked
- Finished the Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and French translations, including text that was previously hard-coded in English
- Adopted the scene-based app life cycle for iOS 27
- Updated to the latest Expo SDK 57 and React Native Firebase releases

## No longer broken

- Fixed Google and other social sign-ins hanging when the sign-in failed; the app now closes the sign-in sheet and shows an error
- Fixed the tab bar turning transparent and drawing its icons over the content on iPad and iOS before 26
- Fixed custom subscription titles not showing on entries
- Fixed article images that failed to load on Android; they now retry through the image proxy
- Fixed unread counts that stayed behind after reading new entries
- Fixed English title case being applied to non-English titles and labels
- Fixed only device-specific settings syncing between devices

name: RTX40MFG-Unlock
body:
**V1.4.1-hotfix.1 fixes Witcher 3 path-traced HairWorks compatibility with ReShade and RenoDX.** It also fixes cases of hair disappearing after loading a save or moving to another area, and keeps hair diagnostics available throughout longer sessions for better bug reports.

For The Witcher 3 DirectX 12, install RTXMFG as **`winmm.dll`** beside `witcher3.exe`. Enable HairWorks, path tracing and **Path Traced Hair** in the game. **Fully restart the game after changing Path Traced Hair or Frame Generation.** Hair support remains experimental and requires a matching game and shader profile.

The ZIP contains only **RTXMFG.dll**, combining the backend and menu. For an existing single-DLL installation, close the game and replace the installed mod DLL, preserving its chosen filename and your settings. Press **Backspace** to open the menu. See the [README](https://github.com/dashdogy/RTX40MFG-Unlock/blob/v1.4.1-hotfix.1/README.md) for installation and supported filenames. SHA-256 checksums for the ZIP and extracted DLL are attached.

**RTX 30 support remains very early and experimental.** The newer RTX 30 development changes are excluded from this hotfix. Vulkan support remains experimental; Dynamic MFG is unavailable on Vulkan.

The release DLL passed all 54 local release regression cases (2,131 assertions), plus hair CPU checks and eight synthetic GPU configurations against both supported Witcher builds. The ReShade resource-device and pool-pressure cases passed in every GPU configuration. This establishes build and harness validation. In-game ReShade/RenoDX hair rendering, repeated save loads and area changes, and long-session logging still await validation with this exact DLL.

## 如何使用

2. 双击对应的 `MAW` 可执行文件，打开启动器
